description: Spark is the Leboncoin iOS design system for SwiftUI and UIKit: theming (colors, typography, spacing, border, elevation, dims), components (Button, Chip, InputOTP, TextInput, ...) and iconography, distributed as a Swift package.
rules: Add the `Spark` product of the `https://github.com/leboncoin/spark-ios.git` package and use `import Spark` to access every component, the theming and the icons. The minimum platform is iOS 17.
Always provide a theme with `.sparkTheme(theme)` on the SwiftUI view hierarchy (use `SparkTheme.shared` for the default Spark theme). Spark SwiftUI components require it.
Prefer the SwiftUI components (`SparkXXX`). New components are SwiftUI only; UIKit components (`SparkUIXXX`) only exist for the legacy components.
Configure SwiftUI components with their environment view modifiers prefixed by `spark` (e.g. `.sparkButtonIntent(.main)`, `.sparkInputOTPDigits(.four)`) instead of init parameters.
Use the theme values (`theme.colors`, `theme.typography`, `theme.layout.spacing`, `theme.border`, `theme.dims`) instead of hardcoded colors, fonts or sizes.
To build a custom view with the look of a component, use its token from `theme.component.xxx` (e.g. `theme.component.inputOTP.colors`).
Use the Spark icons with `Image(spark: \.iconName)` or `UIImage(spark: \.iconName)`.
Never use the code marked `@_spi(SI_SPI)`: it is internal to the Spark team.
